snippet.title: Lloyd the Monkey 3 Expansion: The Warrior Once Called Prince - Trailer
snippet.description:
The SAGE Expo is coming up fast, and since we now have something to show for it, here's the first look at the Lloyd the Monkey 3 Expansion: The Warrior Once Called Prince, set for a Christmas 2025 release!

--Credits--
Music: Dream Raid (Matthew Pablo, opengameart.com)
